description:
A martial artist who was reincarnated as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace, grasping the blade of vengeance.

In a time of war, "Seonhwayun" had the power. He gathered his agenda, Confucian scholars, and six colleagues to purge the corrupt emperor and nobles, and establish an empire where the people would not starve. He placed Confucian scholars on the throne, and gave his six colleagues the positions of the Six Kings of the World to support Confucian scholars. However, Confucian scholars and the Six Kings of the World, who were afraid of the rising status of the Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholars, joined forces to kill Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar. Did the gods accept Confucian scholar's resentment? Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar reincarnates as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace and sharpens his sword of revenge.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
